about: Namesakes split by hand: the tree joins people by name, so these are kept apart section by section (see annotate/merge.py, apply_namesakes).

groups.name: Eurypylus
groups.about: Mysian son of Telephus, who fought as an ally of the Trojans.

groups.name: Eurypylus, son of Mecisteus
groups.about: Argive leader, named as the third of the Argive leaders.

groups.name: Clymene
groups.about: Oceanid, daughter of Ocean and wife of Iapetus (mother of Atlas).

groups.name: Clymene, daughter of Minyas
groups.about: Daughter of Minyas and wife of Phylacus.

groups.name: Deucalion
groups.about: Flood hero, son of Prometheus and Pronoea, father of Hellen; husband of Pyrrha, who repopulated the earth with people made from stones.

groups.name: Passalus
groups.about: One of the two knavish Cercopes brothers, a single individual whose brother is Acmon (or Aclemon).

groups.name: The Cercopes
groups.about: The pair of brothers collectively, who practised knavery and deceived men; a group name rather than a single person.

groups.name: Pallas
groups.about: The Titan, son of Crius and husband of Styx.

groups.name: Pallas, son of Megamedes
groups.about: Father of Selene in the Hymn to Hermes.

groups.name: Pallas, the goddess (Athena)
groups.about: Battle-rousing goddess among the playmates; Pallas here is a title of Athena, not a separate male figure.

groups.name: Cycnus
groups.about: Son of Ares, a spearman who fought and was killed by Heracles in the Hesiodic Shield.

groups.name: Cycnus, son of Poseidon
groups.about: A different Cycnus, son of Poseidon, killed by Achilles at Troy.
